# Non-atomic file writes

Files are created and written directly via Path.write_text after ensuring the parent directory exists. There is no temporary/atomic rename or explicit error handling, so interruptions or write errors can lead to partially written or inconsistent files in the output directory.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/wiki/emitter.py` — `knowledge_compiler.wiki.emitter.WikiEmitter._write`
